parsed.name: E-662压电定位控制器
parsed.description: 用于控制压电定位通道的硬件控制器，可将指定通道移动到目标位置、读取当前位置，并查询控制就绪状态、通道对象、通道相位以及位置上下限。常用于显微镜精密对焦和纳米级位移定位。
parsed.description_en: A hardware controller for piezo positioning channels. It can move a selected channel to a target position, read the current position, and query control readiness, channel object, channel phase, and position limits. It is commonly used for precision microscope focusing and nanoscale positioning.

actions.description: 将指定压电通道移动到目标位置。
actions.description_en: Move the specified piezo channel to a target position.

actions.description: 获取指定压电通道的当前位置。
actions.description_en: Get the current position of the specified piezo channel.

actions.description: 查询控制器是否已就绪。
actions.description_en: Query whether the controller is ready.

actions.description: 获取指定通道的最小位置限制。
actions.description_en: Get the minimum position limit for the specified channel.

actions.description: 获取指定通道的最大位置限制。
actions.description_en: Get the maximum position limit for the specified channel.
